sections.MESSAGE_TO_USER:
**Not yet.** CI is green on `ebfd1edb44a`, but the two reviews ran on `f3d2ab1fd3b`. Nobody has reviewed the fix commit yet. These checks take a few minutes, and I'm running them now:

1. **Review the fix commit.** I'm starting one `adversarial-review` pass on `git diff f3d2ab1fd3b..ebfd1edb44a` only, on a non-flash model. I'm also reading that diff myself and checking the worker's claims against the code:
   - The `takeUnless { it.startsWith("+-") }` guard runs before `removePrefix("+")`.
   - `"++7"` becomes `"+7"`, which `toBigIntegerOrNull()` rejects. Kotlin's version only allows a leading `-`, not `+`.
   - `"+"` becomes `""`, which returns null.
   - The three new test cases really are in the "not a decimal integer" list.
   - The new KDoc sentence says what the reviewer asked for.

   I'm also confirming that the PR head on GitHub is `ebfd1edb44a`. The prose worker's push and the fix commit have the same SHA, so I'm checking that no later wording commit exists. If the head is newer, I'll review that diff instead. The "297 tests pass on AGP 9.1.1 / 9.3.1" result comes from the worker's report, and I'm not treating it as proof.
2. **Re-check all threads and reviews.** I'm re-fetching `gh api repos/flutter/flutter/pulls/196561/comments` and `gh pr view 196561 --json reviews`. I'm also running `pr_triage.dart --threads --pr flutter/flutter#196561` to catch any comment posted since the fix.
3. **Get the readiness verdict.** I'm running `(cd ~/devconfig && dart run bin/pr_triage.dart --ready --pr flutter/flutter#196561)`.
4. **Log the review.** I'm adding the `adversarial-review` entry for `reviewed_sha: ebfd1edb44a` to `~/.agents/review-log.jsonl`. Once the PR is ready, I'll add a `ready` entry too.

**If everything comes back clean, my reply will be:**

> [#196561](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/196561) is ready for your re-approval at `ebfd1edb44a`.
> - **Fix review:** `adversarial-review` of `f3d2ab1fd3b..ebfd1edb44a` found nothing. I read the diff myself and it matches the worker's report:
>   - The `+-` input is rejected before the `+` is stripped.
>   - The `++7` and `+` inputs return null.
>   - The tests cover all three cases.
>   - The KDoc sentence is corrected.
> - **CI:** all green on that head.
> - **Threads:** no new or unanswered threads. `pr_triage --ready` verdict: "<quoted verdict>".
